nodes.label: Rolling local occupancy grid
nodes.rationale: Local building block assumes consistent pose and flat ground; not SLAM or navigation. Evidence does not decay automatically.

nodes.label: Axial Z depth
nodes.rationale: Optical axes X right, Y down, Z forward; must use exposure-time pose and calibrated intrinsics/extrinsics.

nodes.label: Bounded log odds evidence
nodes.rationale: Deduplicated updates per frame, hits win conflicts; cells behind obstacles remain unknown.

nodes.label: TerraOccupancyMapPlugin
nodes.rationale: GPU camera transform and exposure time remain paired across asynchronous completion.

nodes.label: ARKit scene depth
nodes.rationale: ARKit pose alone supplies no depth map; low-confidence returns filtered, initial camera height needs calibration.

nodes.label: MotorAdapter
nodes.rationale: Hardware switch must close and a new command arrive before enable; physical kill switch independently cuts power.

nodes.label: Motor command watchdog
nodes.rationale: Default 200 ms, capped at 1 s; repeated producer timestamp does not renew lease.

nodes.label: Zero-effort coast
nodes.rationale: Zero effort is not a mechanical or electrical brake; chassis can roll.

nodes.label: Signed wheel effort to PWM
nodes.rationale: Positive effort forward, magnitude maps to duty in [0,1]; no GPIO or Zenoh in this crate.

nodes.label: RoverConnection
nodes.rationale: Connect/disconnect off UI thread; two-second direct TCP connection deadline and no multicast scouting.

nodes.label: Monotonic command lease
nodes.rationale: 250 ms refresh lease forces zero; worker publishes latest target at 20 Hz without command queue.

nodes.label: Per-rover cmd_vel
nodes.rationale: Finite targets limited to ±2 m/s and ±2 rad/s; invalid input revokes prior target.

nodes.label: Receiver stopping responsibility
nodes.rationale: Session status is not rover acknowledgement; final zero cannot guarantee delivery over failed link.

nodes.label: Monotonic IMU and VIO sensor contract
nodes.rationale: Body X forward Y left Z up, gravity-free acceleration; independent increasing timestamps and delayed VIO replay.
nodes.norm_label: monotonic imu and vio sensor contract

nodes.label: VIO anchored bounded IMU prediction
nodes.rationale: Not visual odometry or full bias filter; IMU 100 ms, VIO 350 ms freshness defaults.

nodes.label: Differential-drive PI velocity controller
nodes.rationale: Feedforward and back-calculation anti-windup; wheel ratio preserved on saturation; stale or invalid inputs yield zero effort.

nodes.label: Phone mounting calibration
nodes.rationale: Starter assumes screen upward, top edge forward; physical mount rotation, offset and tuning remain unvalidated.

nodes.label: MobileWaypoint
nodes.rationale: Same terra-waypoint follower runs on phone; remote phone follower emits cmd_vel, simulator goals must be cancelled first.

nodes.label: Phone-local simulator occupancy map
nodes.rationale: Depth exposure camera/body pose drive map and marker; packets without pose ignored; no published occupancy snapshot.

nodes.label: Synthetic Avian IMU and VIO feedback
nodes.rationale: Tests controller, not visual odometry from rendered images; each rover has independent estimator/controller.
nodes.norm_label: synthetic avian imu and vio feedback

nodes.label: Swift UniFFI Rust Zenoh integration verification
nodes.rationale: Real Python peer checks lease and final zero and one depth packet; physical iPhone networking untested.
nodes.norm_label: swift uniffi rust zenoh integration verification

nodes.label: Stale iOS Zenoh transport statement
nodes.rationale: Opening paragraph says project does not implement iOS Zenoh transport, later section documents implemented Rust transport through UniFFI.

nodes.label: TerraDepthCameraPlugin
nodes.rationale: Ideal sensor without noise; opaque and alpha-masked render geometry can return depth without colliders.

nodes.label: DepthFrame
nodes.rationale: 256×192 default, 60° vertical FOV, 0.05–30 m; row-major metres, NaN missing.

nodes.label: Asynchronous GPU depth readback
nodes.rationale: CPU receipt is not exposure time; near/raw reverse-Z converts to axial metres and row padding removed.

nodes.label: GPU wall-distance verification
nodes.rationale: Opt-in GPU test compares central pixel to wall at 2.45 m and exercises row padding.

nodes.label: TerraWorldPlugin practice town
nodes.rationale: Seeded 100 m square with roads, buildings, trees, pond and perimeter voxel hills; static Avian colliders except foliage and water.

nodes.label: Terrarium elevation tile patch
nodes.rationale: Flat collider retained because locked rover roll/pitch conflicts with heightfield; relative elevation colors and steep-slope boxes.

nodes.label: bevytiles
nodes.rationale: Web mercator anchor and tile sampling; avoids streaming GPU terrain without colliders.

nodes.label: GMU Johnson Center anchor
nodes.rationale: Bundled zoom-15 tile supports offline default at 38.8297,-77.3075; failure falls back to practice town.

nodes.label: North-west robotics frame
nodes.rationale: Robotics x=-Bevy Z north, y=-Bevy X west; yaw zero north; local tangent projection, not survey projection.

nodes.label: bevy_water pond material
nodes.rationale: Water has no buoyancy model.

nodes.label: RoverFleet
nodes.rationale: 0–32 rovers with stable never-reused IDs; fleet state reports actual spawned count, late clients receive periodic state.

nodes.label: Zenoh bridge
nodes.rationale: Direct peer defaults tcp/127.0.0.1:7447, no multicast router required.

nodes.label: Latched per-rover waypoint goal
nodes.rationale: Published once; fresh cmd_vel cannot preempt; cancel required; Space stops wheels while retaining goal.

nodes.label: Waypoint goal status
nodes.rationale: idle/active/arrived, increasing goal_id and optional token; arrival within .75 m and final yaw .12 rad.

nodes.label: Posed depth frame packet
nodes.rationale: JSON newline binary; depth includes paired exposure time, optical pose and body pose; RGB lacks these fields.

nodes.label: Unsynchronized RGB and depth streams
nodes.rationale: Independent readback counters; matching sequences do not imply exposure synchronization; newest frames replace unsent frames.

nodes.label: ARGOS goal-topic follow-up
nodes.rationale: ARGOS does not speak goal topic yet; contract/encoder and publish-once status CLI remain follow-up.

nodes.label: Simulator incoming command watchdog
nodes.rationale: 500 ms expiry; invalid commands do not renew timeout; goals bypass streamed twist refresh.

nodes.label: Waypoint obstacle planning limitation
nodes.rationale: Follower does not plan around obstacles; chassis stops on Avian collisions.

nodes.label: Dynamic water waves
nodes.rationale: Vertex-height offsets and computed normals; get_wave_point moves objects with water height.

nodes.label: Local Bevy 0.19 water compatibility port
nodes.rationale: Published bevy_water 0.18.1 targets Bevy .18; Terra .19.1 uses mutable material binding and only embed_shaders; optional easing/inspector unvalidated. Standalone license files absent upstream, metadata preserved.

nodes.label: Terrarium terrain raster
nodes.rationale: A square raster with dense yellow, lavender, and muted brown bands forming branching, contour-like patterns; it has no legend, text, geographic labels, or scale.

nodes.label: Color-encoded terrain surface
nodes.rationale: The filename and contour-like false colors suggest encoded terrain information. An elevation decoding formula or geographic identity cannot be established from image pixels alone.

nodes.label: Return wire metadata and a contiguous numpy array; NaN depth stays NaN.
nodes.norm_label: return wire metadata and a contiguous numpy array; nan depth stays nan.

nodes.label: JSON body for terra/rover/<id>/goal. One publish; Terra latches it.
nodes.norm_label: json body for terra/rover/<id>/goal. one publish; terra latches it.
